answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 37356 Country: India Title: I was on my business tour few days back traveling from Mumbai to Chennai. While sleeping in the train I saw that I was with some person in some far lonely place surrounded by mountains Question: I was on my business tour few days back traveling from Mumbai to Chennai. While sleeping in the train I saw that I was with some person in some far lonely place surrounded by mountains. Then suddenly the climate changed and the person next to me told me that Hadhrat Ibrahim (AS) is going to come and then suddenly few distance away from me a person with wings came flying and the person next to me told that Hadhrat Ibrahim (AS) has came, that person also told me that recite any dua so I started reciting dua after few dua my eyes got open. I am very much confused by this dream kindly help me out. Answer ID: 37356 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 549/550/M=1433) Ma-shaAllah, your dream is nice. In-shaAllah, you shall receive goodness and betterment in your life. Earn halal livelihood and abstain from haram completely and follow the sunnah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
